name: graph-beta
description: Beta line of the graph plugin. Same engine as graph 1.7.0 plus the work toward kinds (code / document / package), a TaskManager MCP for medium and large requests, and entry skills per flow. Runs are kept under .harness-run/broker-beta/ so it never touches a stable graph run. Do not enable graph and graph-beta in the same project. Zero runtime dependencies beyond Node 18+.
